message.content: {"claims":[{"id":"Q-02600-01","statement":"会员数120万指的是系统全量会员数，该数字的出数报表、截止日期、是否含注销/黑名单/测试账号等前置条件未确认。","kind":"fact","evidence_status":"reported","qualifiers":["该数字仅作为受访者所述，未提供报表与截止日期等出数条件。"],"evidence":[{"meeting_id":"b78a67f5-b5f4-5966-867e-7f754fbf8e2a","message_id":"MSG-02600","quote":"系统全量会员数"}],"conflict_ids":[],"review":{"status":"pending","note":""}},{"id":"Q-02600-02","statement":"活跃会员的定义、出数报表与核实状态均无法确认，沈总提出过“80万活跃会员”但非受访者本人数据。","kind":"question","evidence_status":"unknown","qualifiers":["活跃的定义和出数报表来源未确认。"],"evidence":[{"meeting_id":"b78a67f5-b5f4-5966-867e-7f754fbf8e2a","message_id":"MSG-02600","quote":"系统里怎么定义"},{"meeting_id":"b78a67f5-b5f4-5966-867e-7f754fbf8e2a","message_id":"MSG-02600","quote":"沈总提的"}],"conflict_ids":[],"review":{"status":"pending","note":""}},{"id":"Q-02600-03","statement":"付费会员卡和免费注册会员为两类会员，描述时应分开。","kind":"opinion","evidence_status":"unknown","qualifiers":["受访者个人判断，非可核对业务规则。"],"evidence":[{"meeting_id":"b78a67f5-b5f4-5966-867e-7f754fbf8e2a","message_id":"MSG-02600","quote":"描述会员时要分开"}],"conflict_ids":[],"review":{"status":"pending","note":""}},{"id":"Q-02600-04","statement":"算复购率时合并还是分开属于业务口径，不在技术核查范围。","kind":"opinion","evidence_status":"unknown","qualifiers":["技术范围不包含复购率口径决策。"],"evidence":[{"meeting_id":"b78a67f5-b5f4-5966-867e-7f754fbf8e2a","message_id":"MSG-02600","quote":"不该由我定"}],"conflict_ids":[],"review":{"status":"pending","note":""}}]}
